class.name: manipulation_position_controllers/JointSpacePositionController
class.description: Joint-space position controller that consumes bounded JointTrajectory references.

class.name: manipulation_position_controllers/TaskSpaceKinematicPositionController
class.description: Task-space kinematic position controller that consumes CartesianTrajectory references, solves IK (differential or QP-based), and writes joint position commands.

class.name: manipulation_position_controllers/TaskSpaceJointImpedanceController
class.description: Task pose → Diff-IK → joint-space impedance → joint/effort. Distinct from a future TaskSpaceCartesianImpedanceController (operational-space / Cartesian stiffness).

class.name: manipulation_position_controllers/JointSpaceImpedanceController
class.description: Joint-space impedance controller (Joint x Dynamic): consumes JointTrajectory position references, shapes them with Ruckig/EMA, and outputs joint effort via tau = Kp(q_ref - q) + Kd(qdot_ref - dq_filt). Prefer this over the position-command JointSpacePositionController on Franka FCI.
